skill.name: bellog-hooks
skill.description: Provides custom React hooks patterns and best practices specific to Bellog. Triggers when creating custom hooks or implementing interactive features.

generated_query: I'm building a blog site and need to add a table of contents sidebar that highlights the active heading as the user scrolls. I want to use React hooks to track which heading is currently visible. I have already written the components for the table of contents, but I need help implementing the logic that observes the headings and updates the active state. The site has a fixed header of 80px. Can you help me create a custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to detect which heading (h2 or h3) is in view and returns its id? The hook should also clean up observers when the component unmounts. Additionally, I need a separate hook that extracts all the headings from the article content and returns an array of `{id, text, level}` objects, handling the case where there are no headings.
